recipes.description: Derived production composition and complete parent wrappers; no scientific intervention.
recipes.assumptions: Technical equivalence control, not historical evidence.

recipes.description: Separate early a/e/i + inherited ww reanalysis from the later English completion already present in the incumbent corridor.
recipes.assumptions: Coronal assimilation feeds reanalysis. Insertion before subsequent j-gemination is a representative decomposition separating inherited ww from later j-created palatal glide sequences, not a newly established total-order edge. Atomic au/eu/iu spell vowel-plus-offglide sequences, not an added vowel nucleus.
recipes.limitations: Only the explicitly represented a/e/i subset is tested; high homorganic uww and jj, other vowel quantities/stresses and the source's separate palatal glide history are not specified. SC031-034 remain incumbent completion/proxy controls. This is not a production-ready full Vww law or a proposed registry verdict.

recipes.description: The same early reanalysis, with a representation-only SC098 control exposing the incumbent ww-based apocope proxy's dependency.
recipes.assumptions: The SC098 executable ww proxy is experimentally extended to its newly vocalized representation. This controls the formal dependency without pretending that ww or diphthong+w encodes sentence stress. Source-backed iuwi~iuw and the unstressed-word apocope account remain distinct from this technical proxy.
recipes.limitations: Not a proposed historical conditioner or approved SC098 change. The paired component-only s+au+w+i probes are hypothetical symbolic controls, not attested lexemes or PGmc reconstructions; they expose the broader literal match domain, not a historical chronology. A productive full law requires explicit prosodic representation and negative controls beyond this corpus; no lexical optionality or grammatical conditioning is introduced. The other limitations of d-aei-ww still apply.

recipes.description: Privately supply Ringe's PGmc giftiz with CAPR's existing root-stress notation; preserve production order and the selected gift target.
recipes.assumptions: Ringe reconstructs PGmc giftiz; the acute accent retains CAPR's selected-input convention rather than claiming author notation. Campbell's gift headword supports the existing short-i target; Ringe's OE gifta citation is explicitly plural and is not recast as a singular attestation.
recipes.limitations: Input-only research assay, not an approved PROTO/PROTOFORM correction or baseline migration. No manuscript-level selected-cell certification, ordinary-PD reorder or resolution of the later sc conditioner is implied.

recipes.description: Place the incumbent ordinary non-high-front mappings before mutation; preserve the literal long-low-front postmutation clause as an explicitly unresolved legacy control.
recipes.assumptions: Relative insertion immediately before mutation implements the source ordinary order with the existing selected-input/stress convention. The late network retains exactly the incumbent long-low-front clause, including its broad initial-palatal triggers; this is an unchanged representation control, not a source-proven sc-specific conditioner.
recipes.limitations: The original gift input is intentionally retained to expose its earlier-raising defect. Component-only inputs are hypothetical symbol controls of the cited vowel domain, not new lexical histories or corpus rows. Existing palatal/stress proxies and later-sc conditioning are not adjudicated. No production semantics/order, historical edge, corpus or baseline is approved.

recipes.description: The same ordinary-before-mutation decomposition with source-raised gift input, testing whether guest can follow its source history without disturbing sheath.
recipes.assumptions: The only experimental corpus-input change is gift2040 with CAPR root stress. Ordinary PD has the source order; the exact incumbent long-low-front clause remains the unadjudicated late control. Neither unchanged finals nor a sheath match proves a complete later historical law.
recipes.limitations: Pending positive/negative component and full-corpus evaluation, individual input/law approvals and disclosed baseline migration. No lexical exceptions, new admission or claimed resolution of stress/new-j/ng/later-sc uncertainties.
